message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; configuration is loaded and passed through without validation of structure or content.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code slice, and no checksum verification, signed URL handling, or pinned revision checks are implemented anywhere in the shown files.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code passes `pretrain=False` to the trainer and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any pretrained weights or serialized models.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection is present anywhere in the visible training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or privacy-preserving mechanisms are referenced or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads data via DataAPI and passes it directly to the engine without any visible shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation are visible on the model outputs before they are consumed or returned by the engine/trainer.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a video anomaly detection pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
